[FACT] User is looking for bike maintenance tips, specifically for hybrid bikes like their Trek FX 3.  
[ASSISTANT] Provided bike maintenance tips for hybrid bikes:  
[ASSISTANT] 1. Check tire pressure weekly (60-80 PSI for hybrid bikes).  
[ASSISTANT] 2. Ensure quick releases and bolts are securely tightened.  
[ASSISTANT] 3. Inspect brake pads for wear and replace when worn down to 1-2 mm.  
[ASSISTANT] 4. Lubricate the chain regularly to reduce wear and prevent corrosion.  
[ASSISTANT] 5. Clean the bike regularly with a soft-bristled brush.  
[ASSISTANT] 6. Clean the chain and wheels with mild soap and water.  
[ASSISTANT] 7. Check chain for wear and stretch; replace if necessary.  
[ASSISTANT] 8. Adjust brake and gear cables as needed.  
[ASSISTANT] 9. Check and adjust derailleurs for smooth shifting.  
[ASSISTANT] 10. Store the bike properly in a dry area away from sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT] 11. Schedule regular tune-ups with a professional mechanic.  
[ASSISTANT] 12. Keep a maintenance log to track activities.  
[ASSISTANT] 13. Specific tips for Trek FX 3: check suspension and inspect disc brakes.
